name: Mrs. Dodds
excerpt: Mrs. Dodds is a math teacher who transforms into a supernatural creature.
notes: Mrs. Dodds is a math teacher at Yancy Academy who appears to have a particular dislike for Percy Jackson. She is described as wearing a black leather jacket and having a mean demeanor. During a field trip, she transforms into a supernatural creature with glowing eyes, talons, and bat wings, revealing her true nature before being vaporized by Percy.
